notes: Beta not ready: visual proof pack and remaining nested --surface migration still open.
Do not claim full E2E/packaged smoke for the overhaul passed.

findings.summary: None wallpaper posted legacy {kind:none} as wallpaperJson; now clears via empty string + Rust normalize.

Nested opaque var(--surface) inside translucent panels hid wallpapers; high-traffic chrome (.settings-section, .message-bubble, .btn-secondary) migrated to --core-*-overlay tokens. Residual nested tint risks tracked in reports/background-rule-inventory.json; visual proof still required.
Tool header actions wrap/condense into More menu; Close/Back always reachable.
Wordmark uses solid --core-text-primary; no background-clip text.
Interface transparency setting 0–60% with tokenized panel alphas; body wash only when no wallpaper. Superseded residual work tracked under wallpaper-nested-opaque-surface.
Removed window.alert placeholder for project context search.
Ask-first expand prompt remembered per tool for the session; switching tools no longer re-prompts for already-asked tools until Adaptive Window Sizing mode changes.
Additional color-mix(... var(--surface)) rules can still occlude wallpaper when nested in translucent panels; see background-rule-inventory.json.
